title: Case: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started
context: The merchant warehouse has a receipt but the authorised refunds team has no review case. The next action is to submit that receipt to start review.
initial_request: The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.

events.body: Inline receipt WH-5788: RT-4773 for TG-1869 physically received at 08:10 UTC today. We can confirm receipt, but our receiving role does not approve refunds.

The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.

The battery in my doorbell is dead, which is probably why nobody heard the driver.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the receipt reference to the merchant's authorised refunds team.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Whinmoor Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Send the receipt reference to the merchant's authorised refunds team. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Registered review is not an approved refund or money received.
Escalates to a supervisor or a safety, legal or welfare team because of the casual remark in the escalation
Mentions legal action, danger or welfare in reply to the casual remark
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please register the refund review for TG-1869 / RT-4773 using warehouse receipt WH-5788. Notify us of the case reference and next update date; receipt alone is not refund approval.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-035: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. A harmless remark with an alarming word was added ("The battery in my doorbell is dead, which is probably why nobody heard the driver."); the key is the seed's. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
